title: The comet volatile population (GEN.495): species ranges and log-normal scatters

sources.rob24: Robinson, Malamud, Opitom, Perets and Blum 2024, arXiv:2403.15644, and its database (Edinburgh DataShare, doi 10.7488/ds/7723, df_comp_all.csv, 909 rows, 69 comets): per-species statistics of the coma ratio to water at a heliocentric distance of at most 2 AU, computed by the body composition research lane (G1 section 2.3)
sources.hp22: Harrington Pinto et al. 2022, arXiv:2209.09985: CO, CO2 and H2O in comets; (CO + CO2)/H2O median 18 +/- 4 percent (18 comets), CO2 2 to 30 percent (23 comets within 2.5 AU), CO 0.3 to 26 percent (32 comets within 2.5 AU)
sources.coch15: Cochran et al. 2015, Space Science Reviews 197, 9, arXiv:1507.00761: depleted fractions of the optical taxonomy, 37 percent of Jupiter-family comets against 18.5 percent of long-period comets
sources.cor25: Cordiner et al. 2025, arXiv:2508.18209 (JWST, 3I/ATLAS): CO2/H2O 7.6 +/- 0.3 and CO/H2O 1.65 +/- 0.09 at 3.32 AU

total_carbon_oxide.name: CO + CO2
total_carbon_oxide.label: COMPUTED
total_carbon_oxide.limit: the median 18 is read (Harrington Pinto 2022, 18 comets); the 0.2 dex width is the scatter among single comets computed from the database: log10 of (CO + CO2)/H2O of the 9 comets with both measured within 2.5 AU gives 0.197 dex (8 comets within 2.0 AU give 0.138, the widest is kept); the sample is small and its own median is 15

co_fraction.name: CO/(CO + CO2)
co_fraction.label: COMPUTED
co_fraction.limit: the class medians are computed from the periodic and long-period medians (1.2 and 14.5, 8.4 and 8), which come from different comet subsets; the Halley type takes the periodic value

carbon_chain_depleted.name: carbon-chain-depleted
carbon_chain_depleted.label: READ
carbon_chain_depleted.limit: the two class fractions are read (37 and 18.5 percent); the Halley type takes 0.25, which no source gives

co_over_h2o.label: READ
co_over_h2o.limit: one measured object (1.65 +/- 0.09 at 3.32 AU) sets the upper edge; the lower edge 0.01 is the earlier design bound

co2_over_h2o.label: READ
co2_over_h2o.limit: one measured object (7.6 +/- 0.3) lies far beyond the 2 to 37 percent of Solar System comets, so it is drawn separately; the edges are design
